The '''Poporov merchants''' were a group of [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] from [[Armstiss]] who at one point [[Poporov merchant rebellion|rebelled]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Their rebellion was ended when Imperials, including [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Strayit]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Zertik Strom/Legends|Zertik Strom]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Marshall Awe]]'', came to prevent resistance. Strom took a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt meant for Strayit from one of the rebels, before pushing a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] down the pants of the [[Unidentified Poporov merchants leader|leader]] of the merchants and throwing him off a cliff into the rest of the group. The explosion [[Death/Legends|killed]] the majority of merchants and destroyed their stalls, with those left to scared to show further defiance.<ref name="VSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Poporov merchants were first mentioned in the second part of ''[[Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel]]'', an article released in [[2013]] on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog]] and written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]]. The article does not make clear if the events involving them take place in the [[Rebellion era]] or the [[Rise of the Empire era]].
